name: Redact Email Addresses
description: A regex replace standing in for the everyday cleanup step — strip personal data out of text before it reaches a model or a log.

data.comment:
# Redact Email Addresses

Replaces email addresses in text using a regular expression. Use it to strip personal data before text reaches a model or a log.

**How it works:** "Text" holds a sentence with two addresses. "Redact" finds every match of its pattern and swaps in the replacement string. "Result" shows the cleaned text. It runs locally with no model or key.

**Try this:** Change the pattern on "Redact" to match phone numbers, or set count to 1 to replace only the first address.
